claims.statement: Tom Allen seconded George Seddons (with Patsey Curtin) against John Lafferty on Carroll Island, Illinois, on 25 January 1870, and took charge of Seddons before the fight.
claims.excerpt: Lafierty was seconded by Jack Looney and Tom Ketly. Seadeng was seconded Allen and Patsey Curtin.

claims.statement: Tom Allen seconded George Carey (with Patsey Curtin) against James C. Gallagher on Carroll Island, Illinois, on 25 January 1870.
claims.excerpt: Carey was seconded by Tom Allen and Patsey Curtin, and Gallagher was seconded by Tom Kelly

claims.statement: Tom Allen threw up the sponge for George Carey, who was beaten by James C. Gallagher, on Carroll Island in 18 minutes.
claims.excerpt: On the call of time Alien threw up the sponge for Carey, amid cheers tor Gallagher

claims.statement: Tom Allen was one of the party on the steamer Lady Pike for the excursion from St. Louis to Carroll Island, Illinois, on 25 January 1870.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was knocked out of time by Charley Gallagher in a fight in a cornfield near the old distillery on Carroll Island in the summer of 1869.
claims.excerpt: Allen was knocked outof time im a little “mill,” with Charley Gallagher last summer.

fights.excerpt: Allen was knocked outof time im a little “mill,” with Charley Gallagher last summer.
fights.notes: Recalled in passing as a 'little mill' in summer 1869; no details of rounds or result beyond being knocked out of time.

notes: Allen seconded in two fights on the Lady Pike excursion and is recalled as having lost to Charley Gallagher in 1869.
